actors.name: Tidepool
actors.private_context: Tidepool has a newsletter with 5,000 subscribers. They plan to send a launch email on 2026-09-22T08:00:00-07:00. The email includes a personal note from the founder and a waitlist link above the fold. Tidepool wants at least 200 subscribers to click through and join the beta waitlist within 72 hours.

shared_context: The newsletter has a typical click-through rate of 6%. The beta email is scheduled to be sent to all 5,000 subscribers at the start time. The email contains a personal note from the founder and a waitlist link above the fold. Subscribers may or may not open the email, click the link, and join the waitlist.

starting_events.description: Tidepool sends the beta launch email to all 5,000 newsletter subscribers.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 200 distinct subscribers clicked through to the beta waitlist sign-up page within 72 hours of the email send (i.e., before 2026-09-25T08:00:00-07:00). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
